# AMTDEX SOFT

> AMTDEX SOFT is a software and information technology company based in Ibb, Yemen. This website describes its services, project portfolio and technical articles.

## Website

- [Home](https://amtdex.com/): Company introduction and product interface demonstrations.
- [Services](https://amtdex.com/services): Software, websites, mobile applications and business systems.
- [Portfolio](https://amtdex.com/portfolio): Published project information.
- [About](https://amtdex.com/about): Company information and frequently asked questions.
- [Contact](https://amtdex.com/contact): Official contact options and enquiry form.
- [Technical blog](https://blog.amtdex.com/): Published technical articles.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://amtdex.com/sitemap.xml): Current public URLs.
- [Blog feed](https://blog.amtdex.com/feed): Published article feed.

Product interface demonstrations may contain illustrative data. Consult each page for current information. This site does not currently publish an AI tool API; the discovery catalog therefore contains no tool entries.
